description: This PHP source file belongs to the Opencart admin controller for managing country-related events. It defines the 'Country' class with methods to add, edit, and delete countries, which internally create specific tasks for the system to process. The class hooks into after-effects of country data modifications to enqueue tasks for cache or data updates.

classes.name: Country
classes.description: Controller class that manages event handling for country data changes, such as adding, editing, or deleting countries, by scheduling corresponding tasks.

methods.name: addCountry
methods.description: Handles the event after a country is added, scheduling tasks to update country listings and details.

methods.name: editCountry
methods.description: Handles the event after a country is edited, scheduling tasks to update country listings and the specific country info.

methods.name: deleteCountry
methods.description: Handles the event after a country is deleted, scheduling tasks to update country listings and remove the deleted country.
